title: Earthy Japanese Udon Noodle Soup
description: A hearty and comforting Japanese-inspired noodle soup made with udon noodles, earthy mushrooms, and vibrant vegetables.
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the soy sauce, sake, sugar, and sesame oil to the pot.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the pot and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the udon noodles to the pot and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until they are tender.
Stir in the sesame seeds and green chili pepper.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the hot udon noodle soup garnished with green onions and sesame seeds.
Drizzle with sesame oil and soy sauce (if using).
